The  Executive  Chairman  and  the  Chairman,
Co-ordinator or appointed Member shall have the authority
in the Government and Non Government institute to—

(a)
engage in negotiation with the concerned parties in
order to solve their dispute whatsoever, with good
intention of solving such disputes in the Government
organisations for the benefit of the people;

(b)
engage  in  dialog  with  concern  authorities  in  any
Police Station within any administrative District is
Sri Lanka, for the welfare of the people, in order to
solve the dispute where an injustice has taken place;
and
